effects: Pulls `amount` mETH (the vault's collateral 0xd5F7…ADfa, set at init) from the signer to the vault via safeTransferFrom. This spends the signer's mETH allowance to the vault.
Mints active vault shares, worth the amount deposited, to `onBehalfOf`, who may be someone other than the signer. The share count comes from storage (activeStake/activeShares).
formats.shown: Deposit X mETH into the vault, with the shares credited to the beneficiary address. The vault address is also shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of vault shares minted to onBehalfOf is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_)` uses storage values. The descriptor shows only `#.amount` and `#.onBehalfOf`.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. The deposited mETH amount and the beneficiary are already shown.

effects: Burns the signer's active vault shares worth `amount` mETH, rounded up (previewWithdraw, Ceil). The signer's position shrinks.
Queues `amount` mETH into next epoch's withdrawals and credits the withdrawal shares to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim the mETH after that epoch ends.
No tokens move in this call. The queued amount stays slashable until it is claimed.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of X mETH from the vault, owned by the claimer address.

findings.title: withdraw: the screen does not say that the mETH arrives only after the next epoch and can be slashed meanwhile.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _withdraw: `uint256 epoch = currentEpoch() + 1; withdrawals[epoch] = withdrawals_ + withdrawnAssets`. onSlash reduces `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1]`. The intent is 'Request withdrawal'.
findings.fix: Optionally reword the intent to 'Request withdrawal (claimable next epoch)'. The final amount depends on slashing and cannot be shown.

effects: Burns `shares` of the signer's active vault shares.
Queues the mETH value of those shares (previewRedeem from storage) into next epoch's withdrawals and credits it to `claimer`. Only `claimer` can claim it later.
No tokens move in this call.
formats.shown: Queue N raw shares for withdrawal to the claimer. The share count is an unscaled integer, and the mETH value is not shown.

findings.title: redeem: the share amount is shown as a raw 18-decimal integer, which nobody can read.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem field `#.shares` has format 'raw', label 'Vault shares (raw)'. Case 2 renders '987654321123456789'. ERC4626Math._decimalsOffset() returns 0, so shares use mETH's 18 decimals.
findings.fix: Use format 'unit' with params {decimals: 18, base: 'shares'} (or similar) and update the interpolated intent to match.

findings.title: redeem: the mETH amount queued for those shares is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares())` depends on storage.
findings.fix: None from calldata. A note that the shares convert to mETH at the current rate would help.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawal for `epoch` as claimed.
Transfers the signer's full withdrawal for that epoch (withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender), read from storage) in mETH from the vault to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal of epoch E to the recipient address. No asset or amount is shown.

findings.title: claim: the screen never names the asset (mETH) the recipient receives.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. The intent is 'Claim withdrawal' and the interpolated intent is 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'. Case 3 has no token anywhere on the screen.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent and labels, e.g. 'Claim mETH withdrawal' and 'Claim epoch {epoch} mETH to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the amount transferred is read from storage and cannot be shown.

effects: Marks the signer's withdrawals for every listed epoch as claimed.
Transfers the sum of the signer's withdrawals for those epochs (read from storage) in mETH from the vault to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals of the listed epochs to the recipient address. No asset or amount is shown.

findings.title: claimBatch: the screen never names the asset (mETH) the recipient receives.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount)`. The intent is 'Claim withdrawals' and the interpolated intent is 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'. Case 4 shows no token.
findings.fix: Name mETH in the intent and interpolated intent, e.g. 'Claim mETH withdrawals'.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total amount transferred is summed from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i])`, where _claim reads withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender).
